stem.text: A plane polarised light wave of intensity $I_\text{0}$ is incident normally on a polarising filter. The initial intensity of the transmitted wave is 0.
A second polarising filter is then inserted between the source and the first filter. Its transmission axis is at $45^{\circ}$ to the transmission axis of the first filter, as shown.

stem.alt: Light ray passing through two polarising filters shown as squares; the source is labelled source of polarised light, intensity I0, and the labels describe the transmission axes and the direction of travel of the light wave.

stem.text: What is the intensity of the transmitted wave from the filter combination?
